measurement_note: Size S is the number of points. Legal tiers 48, 192, and 768 span 16x. Exactly two points share x = 1, forming a vertical base of length S; every other x- and y-coordinate is unique, and the farthest x is S - 1, so the answer is S(S - 2). The accepted grouped-extrema method scans Theta(S) data. A correct calibrated alternative enumerates every point pair as a possible axis-parallel base in Theta(S^2); it must pass every output and fail only the scaling verdict.
